nodes.title: Background
nodes.summary:
This partial document outlines a tender issued by the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) for electrical works related to the Phase II extension of the Namma Metro. Key points include:

*   **Objective:** Invitation for sealed tenders from eligible contractors to handle the design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems for selected stations.
*   **Scope of Work:** The contractor is required to provide electrical infrastructure including station lighting systems, power distribution panels, emergency backup systems, and earthing/lightning protection.
*   **Location:** The project will be executed at selected stations along the North–South corridor in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
*   **Process:** The document initiates the instructions to bidders, specifically addressing bid submission procedures.

structure.title: Eligibility Criteria

nodes.title: Financial Qualification
Minimum Turnover
nodes.summary: This partial document outlines the financial and technical qualifications required for bidders, along with the scope of work. Key financial requirements include a minimum annual turnover of INR 100 crore over the last three years, a positive net worth for the previous financial year, and the submission of audited balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and auditor certification. Technical qualifications mandate at least two successfully completed similar electrical infrastructure projects (in metro rail or large infrastructure) within the last seven years, with each project having a minimum contract value of INR 30 crore. Additionally, bidders must possess qualified engineers specializing in electrical engineering, power systems, and safety compliance. The document also introduces the section on the Scope of Work.
